title: Flight Control Command
description: Ground-to-air messages on the 'flight-control' RTCDataChannel (unordered, no retransmits), sent by the ground GUI and relayed by the ground runtime. fc-command is a continuous 20 Hz stream while the phone pilot is unlocked; stick values are normalized to [-1, 1] around neutral (1500 us for roll/pitch/yaw, the FC's ap_hover_throttle for throttle) and the air side maps and clamps them. The air drops an fc-command whose seq is not newer than the last one it applied. fc-control and fc-setting are idempotent: the GUI resends them until the air's fc-state reflects them. See ARCHITECTURE.md section 7.

sentAt.description: Ground wall-clock time in ms, for diagnostics only.

action.description: unlock: completed unlock manoeuvre. abort: hover (all sticks neutral) and lock. release: stop overriding, the safety pilot's RC applies.
